events.title: Draconids peak
events.summary: Up to 10 an hour under a perfect dark sky, fewer in practice. Debris from comet 21P/Giacobini-Zinner, hitting the atmosphere at 20 km/s. Best after midnight when the radiant is high.

events.title: Aurora forecast: Kp 6 (G2)
events.summary: NOAA forecasts a geomagnetic storm peaking around 09:00 UTC. Aurora possible from about 55° latitude and poleward (Scotland, Scandinavia, Canada). Look north from a dark spot after dusk; a phone camera on night mode sees it before your eyes do.

events.title: Southern Taurids peak
events.summary: Up to 5 an hour under a perfect dark sky, fewer in practice. Debris from comet 2P/Encke, hitting the atmosphere at 27 km/s. Best after midnight when the radiant is high.

events.title: Orionids peak
